rationale: Widens the implementation-path set the remediation-history gate enforces. Review found that documentation snapshots, tests, and normalization policy could change without a covering authority checkpoint, so an admitted origin snapshot and the digest attesting it could be replaced together under one identity.
effect: Applies to a commit only when its parent already contains this marker. Commits authored under the narrower rule keep being judged by it, because their checkpoints could not have scoped a path that was not yet governed; condemning them would force either a false green or a rewrite of history.
